name: codex-image-forwarding
goal: Forward attached images and browser screenshot results as Claude image blocks while preserving text, highlight metadata, call ownership and fail-closed unsupported media; record remaining desktop parity gates.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Explicit image-forwarding authorization; spec records structured SDK/MCP images, preserved highlight and call metadata, fail-closed unsupported media, bounded payloads and outstanding desktop/voice/phone parity gates. Eight integration assertions failed on the unchanged gateway, then passed unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: SDK streaming user envelope carries native image blocks; MCP tool replies retain native screenshots, text, error metadata and image resource URI. Media validation happens before tool delivery and model inference. Native provider switching and unsupported media remain explicit.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Same 8 initially failing gateway integration assertions passed unchanged; 22 focused tests cover ordering, mutation, image validation, limits, batch atomicity and cancellation. Live Claude Agent SDK attachment and screenshot tool-result tests both read an unpredictable four-digit code from image bytes.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
